name: slopmax-desktop
description: The desktop app: an Electron shell over the daemon's HttpApi, with the UI's desktop build and the bundled CLI

//.effect: Main's whole program: services and layers for the CLI, the proxy's state, preferences and the event stream; Schema decodes everything the CLI prints and the window sends; HttpApiClient talks to the daemon.
//.@effect/platform-node: FileSystem, Path and the ChildProcessSpawner on Electron's Node, to read and write the preferences and run the bundled CLI. Only src/main/ imports it.
//.@slopmax/domain: The daemon's SlopmaxApi and events, the bridge's schemas, the report and doctor shapes the CLI prints, and the words the tray and notifications use.
//.@slopmax/test: it.effect / it.live and the in-memory FileSystem for the tests.
//.@slopmax/ui: Its desktop build is the window; build.ts runs it and copies dist/desktop into the app.
//.@electron/packager: Packages the app (asar, en-US only) with the CLI in resources/bin: the same bytes as electron-builder, in half the time (RUNTIME.md §3).
//.playwright-core: Drives the packaged app under Xvfb in the smoke test and the screenshot script (`_electron`), with no browser download.
//.measured: See README.md: the packaged app's size and the memory of every process, measured 2026-11-01.
